fields.note:
🛑 The temperature error is the worst of its kind in the set. The EPDM gasket page understated its own compound by 20 °C; this page understates silicone by 100 °C — and high temperature is the entire reason anyone chooses silicone. A buyer with a 150 °C pump reads +120 and leaves.

sections.title: From compound to certification
sections.chip: Correct process · silicone needs its post-cure named
sections.live: LIVE H2 → From Compound to Certification · six steps · “compression moulding” is right on this page

fields.label: Steps
rows: Material compounding — polymer blending, additive integration and batch QC in our in-house lab. The silicone grade is set here against the medium and the temperature, before any dimension matters.
Mould design and CNC tool manufacture, in-house, held as a controlled record. Tooling is compound-specific — silicone and FKM shrink differently, so one part in three compounds is not one tool.
Compression moulding — [no change; correct on this part]

Post-cure and trimming — silicone parts are oven post-cured to drive off residual volatiles, which is what gives the compound its full temperature performance and low odour. The live text mentions post-cure without saying why it matters here.
Quality inspection — dimensional check, hardness, and compression set on batch samples to ASTM D395 Method B.

Export packaging — industrial packing with documentation. ISPM-15 treated pallets where timber packaging is used. Inlays are packed uncompressed, since an insert stored under load arrives already set.
fields.note:
Six steps, six kept — the process is right and three steps gain the detail that makes it specific.
Step 04 is the one that matters on a silicone page. Post-curing silicone is a real, non-obvious production step, and a supplier who names it has clearly moulded silicone before.
Step 02 also carries a commercial fact worth stating: one part in three compounds needs more than one tool, which is why the minimum run is per compound

notes: The process block must render from the part record.
“Post-cure” on silicone is a searchable technical term and a credibility marker to anyone specifying it.
Numbered steps are an <ol>.
